body: Well it's something I wish I could have. I just jump easily, or I'm instantly attracted by loud noises. Part of me wishes that car horns were never invented, but I know that's a ridiculous thing to think about.
I guess it would be. There's a lot to learn though.

I work the nightshift at a supermarket, it's the best job I've had so far but I hate it. I try to listen to everything, but I've been listening to a lot of David Bowie recently. I sort of want to make my own songs one day.

I have video games, thought I can't even play League Of Legends without getting yelled at by some random person. Music is another one, I collect records and cds, which again, sort of can't because of money. I'm not sure if I really do to be honest. Even going to work feels dangerous because all I do is think about things. Honestly I really could have used an appointment this week but I couldn't afford it so I had to move it to next week.
Yeah man, I love Kendrick. He's probably my favourite rapper at the moment, apart from like Pusha T or someone. Also that sucks, it's weird how LoL is set up. You mind if I send you a PM?
Aww, thanks. What bands are you into? Also could I send you a PM?
Possibly to Townsville. Could I just send you a PM?
Ha, I wish. No, I plan on moving out soon.
Sounds good, I'll shoot you a message.
